PREC.role: cumulative gauge series in the normalized observed CSV

PRCP.role: unadjusted gauge-derived increment used for sensor comparison

PRCPSA.description: Snow Adjusted Total Precipitation daily increment

WTEQ.role: measured pillow series and SWE validation target

SNRR.description: Daily SWE increases as a percentage of total precipitation

empirical_reconstruction.scope: non-water-year-reset days with same-day PRCP and consecutive WTEQ
empirical_reconstruction.interpretation: This exact station-period reconstruction demonstrates dependence on pillow SWE change; it is not asserted as a universal NRCS algorithm contract.

primary_window_analysis.window_definition: October 1 through observed positive WTEQ peak date, inclusive

supported: Unadjusted PREC or PRCP is not a hard physical ceiling on Snowbird snowfall or pillow SWE.
The current p8.cli is mass-limited relative to the pillow target in the median primary window under a no-lateral-import assumption.
The fixture-to-target comparison must retain gauge undercatch, elevation, footprint, canopy, and redistribution hypotheses.
not_supported: PRCPSA as independent validation of WTEQ or modeled SWE.
PRCPSA as truth, a calibration target, or direct precipitation-correction authority.
Any forcing multiplier or additive correction inferred directly from the fixture-to-PRCPSA ratio.
Attribution of the remaining modeled SWE deficit to a single forcing or snow-physics mechanism.

claim_limits: The AWDB query responses are checksummed but not committed; future provider revisions can change their bytes or values.
PRCPSA incorporates WTEQ and is circular when WTEQ is also the validation target.
The reconstruction is empirical for Snowbird and the frozen period, not a normative provider algorithm.
Point sensors do not resolve hillslope-scale lateral redistribution or representativeness.
No model run, fixture climate value, observation value, or production snow physics was changed by this diagnostic.
